criteria.criterion: CSR proof is canonical, constrained, and not a generic signing oracle
criteria.command: cargo test -p types --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; cargo test -p service-kms --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; openssl req -inform DER -in /tmp/cellos-relay.csr -noout -verify
criteria.evidenceRef: Types passed 41/41 and KMS 58/58. KMS self-verifies provider proof over its canonical CRI, and OpenSSL independently reported Certificate request self-signature verify OK.

criteria.criterion: one-shot enrollment lifecycle binds the exact supervisor and stages or cleans up atomically
criteria.evidenceRef: The exact wrong-order regression passed. Full KMS coverage also passed supervisor transfer poisoning, exhaustion, restart mismatch, commit-from-Staged-only, cleanup tombstones, and provider-confirmed destruction.

criteria.criterion: the development enrollment key stays Silo-contained and nonce-bound
criteria.command: cargo test -p service-silo --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; LLVM_OBJCOPY=/home/dmin/.rustup/toolchains/nightly-2026-05-01-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/llvm-objcopy cargo check -p service-silo --features development-silo-provider --target aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat
criteria.evidenceRef: Silo passed 17/17. The exact AArch64 guest/package lane completed clean; purpose-bound create/sign/destroy/promote frames carry a fresh nonce and no export or generic signing command.

criteria.criterion: service-net accepts only strict active certificate/profile/manifest bindings
criteria.command: cargo test -p service-net --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; (cd tools/relay-enroll && python3 -m unittest relay_enroll_test); (cd tools/relay-server && python3 -m unittest relay_manifest_test)
criteria.evidenceRef: Net passed 24/24, relay-enroll 10/10, and relay-manifest 11/11. Bounded structural DER, clientAuth-only EKU, canonical SPKI/NodeId, TLS 1.3, chain, path, and closed-schema checks reject malformed or ambiguous inputs.

criteria.criterion: recovery and authenticated-time dependencies fail closed
criteria.source: full KMS/net suites and current-tree final security re-review
criteria.evidenceRef: Authenticated journal state covers lifecycle and restart/time floors. Production load/persist and authenticated-time providers remain unavailable, so KMS and net seal or refuse relay mTLS rather than resetting floors or accepting raw/default time.

criteria.criterion: bare-metal KMS and development-Silo compile lanes remain clean
criteria.command: cargo check -p service-kms --target riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf; cargo check -p service-kms --target aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat; LLVM_OBJCOPY=/home/dmin/.rustup/toolchains/nightly-2026-05-01-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/llvm-objcopy cargo check -p service-silo --features development-silo-provider --target aarch64-unknown-none-softfloat
criteria.evidenceRef: RV64 KMS, AArch64 KMS, and the exact current-tree AArch64 development-Silo lane completed clean.

criteria.criterion: unqualified production candidates cannot produce an image
criteria.command: python3 scripts/test_check_production_relay_image.py; direct checker invocation with unqualified inputs
criteria.evidenceRef: Checker tests passed 2/2. The direct checker invocation exited 1 fail-closed, builder/checker paths produced no image, and production remains BLOCKED_PENDING_PHASE_6_7_8.
